Job Title: LLM Scientist
Experience: 4+ Years
Location: Pune/Nagpur (Work From Office)




Job Summary:




We are looking for an experienced LLM Scientist to research, prototype, and evaluate advanced Generative AI and Agentic AI systems. The role involves LLM fine-tuning, RAG architecture, statistical experimentation, model evaluation, and Python-based GenAI development.




Key Responsibilities

Design and prototype Agentic AI and multi-agent systems.
Build and improve RAG pipelines using chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and reranking.
Fine-tune LLMs using LoRA/QLoRA.
Conduct model, prompt, architecture, A/B, and ablation experiments.
Build evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for GenAI systems.
Analyze groundedness, hallucination, relevance, and retrieval quality.
Apply statistical methods and classical machine learning techniques.
Research emerging LLM and Agentic AI technologies.
Collaborate with engineering teams to transition prototypes into production.

Mandatory Skills

4+ years of experience in LLM, Machine Learning, NLP, or Generative AI.
Strong Python programming skills.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Transformers, and Generative AI fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, RAG, and LLM fine-tuning.
Proficiency in LangChain and LangGraph.
Working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Experience with LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning.
Experience with vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB, or Pinecone.
Understanding of embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and reranking.
Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.
Experience with ML evaluation metrics such as Precision, Recall, F1, and ROC-AUC.
Experience evaluating hallucination, groundedness, relevance, and retrieval quality.



Good to Have

Knowledge of BERT, NLP, sentiment analysis, XGBoost, or anomaly detection.
Research background or publications in NLP/LLMs.
Experience working in regulated enterprise domains.
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
